value.rationale: The disputed theorem is presented as the canonical K-g-fusion dual construction. The failure occurs in dimension two with one block, so it is not a convergence pathology, and it changes exact reconstruction of Kf. The invariance equivalence identifies the precise geometric boundary behind the proof error and explains why later K-fusion dual theory retains an explicit projection onto R(K).
